messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v3.7.0 -> 6% (regions: global). Initiator: rachel. Command: `/deploy start --version v3.7.0 --percent 6 --note \"kv fix + batching opt\"`

rachel: launching canary now. Preflight checks passed. Change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. I'll monitor kv eviction, p99, and 5xx.

emily: QA smoke passed locally. Release notes pushed: https://docs.redwood/releases/v3.7.0 — includes kv cache eviction resilience and smarter batching.

ton y: infra watches in place. keep an eye on kvcache_misses and eviction_count. small bump strategy as usual: 6 -> 15 -> 30 if green.

infra-bot: ALERT: eu-central kvcache_eviction_count increased 3x over baseline in the last 2m. p99 latency +90ms.

emily: I can repro on staging with a synthetic workload that stresses hot keys. New batching seems to amplify local hot-key patterns.

rachel: OK hold on further bumps. Do not proceed to 15%. Pin scope eu-central until we triage.

ops-sre: Vote: HOLD. Pinning recommended. Rolling pause and disable further percent increases. Rollback criteria: sustained eviction_count > 2x baseline for 5m OR p99 > 400ms for 3m. Rollback steps summarized: 1) revert to v3.6.5 full (if needed): `/deploy rollback --version v3.6.5 --percent 100` 2) or apply config rollback to batching: `/config apply --path /ops/batching/legacy.json` 3) verify metrics and unpin.

ton y: I can assemble a targeted config revert that only touches batching heuristics for eu-central; less noisy than full rollback. I'll prep the PR and smoke in staging.

emily: If config revert is fast and tests pass, prefer that over full rollback to avoid churn during change window.

infra-bot: NOTE: spike appears tied to sequences with repeated short prompts (conversational loops). Sampled traces: model-host-7 shows GC pressure then connection retries.

rachel: Given GC/retry signal, we should prioritize config revert + limited instance drain on model-host-7, then re-evaluate. @tony can you coordinate a graceful drain?

ton y: Will do. I'll drain the node and apply the config revert PR if green. ETA ~12m for PR + canary.

ops-sre: Documenting decision: Pin applied to eu-central. Revert-first strategy. Postmortem owner: rachel. Support blurb ready?

emily: Draft for support: "Investigating increased KV eviction and latency in EU-Central affecting a small % of requests. Engineers are triaging; mitigation in progress." Short and shareable.

rachel: Good. I'm posting that to #support. Also adding a short note to release notes to flag the hold.

infra-bot: ALERT: eu-central eviction_count now 3.8x (4m window). If not improved in 10m, recommend roll forward with revert or full rollback.

ton y: PR opened for batching revert: https://git.redwood/pr/4972. Running CI + staging smoke.

emily: CI green on PR, staging smoke looks stable with revert. Recommend apply to eu-central only.

ops-sre: Approve targeted config apply. Execute `/config apply --path /ops/batching/revert-eu-central.json --scope eu-central` and monitor for 5m.

deploy-bot: Config apply command recorded by ops-sre. Applying revert to eu-central now.

infra-bot: NOTE: after revert, eviction_count trending down toward baseline. p99 latency improving.

rachel: Great — unpinning eu-central and continuing rollout plan. Resume command: `/deploy resume --version v3.7.0 --scope eu-central` to proceed after manual approval.

ops-sre: Recommendation: resume to 15% only after 10m of stable metrics. Also schedule a follow-up to tune batching heuristics for mixed workloads.

rachel: Resuming to 15% for eu-central now. Will watch for further anomalies. Thanks team. :rocket:
